title: HelperFSStatResult
description: Result of the helper fs service's stat op: the metadata a row shows, without enumerating the parent. Kind never spells `symlink` here because the path is followed — it is the kind of the object a link names.

kind.description: The kind of object, in internal/filesystem.Kind's own closed vocabulary: `regular`, `dir`, `symlink`, `other` (a FIFO, socket or device) or `unreadable` (the entry exists but its metadata could not be read).

size.description: The object's size in bytes. Zero is a real size — an empty file, a directory on some filesystems — not an absence.

mtimeNs.description: Modification time in Unix nanoseconds. Negative is a pre-epoch timestamp, which a digest and a version comparison treat as any other value.

mode.description: The object's os.FileMode bits, as Go states them: the permission bits plus the type flags. 32 bits, so a caller can round-trip it into a file mode.
